Full index — EU AI Studies Monitor

items.docs:
Official CTIS lifecycles of medicinal clinical trials with exact AI text evidence and separate application, country-status, recruitment, safety and results events.

Attribution: i6eal analysis of the public Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) with disclosed evidence, time and privacy rules.

Reuse: Public CTIS data from the European Medicines Agency, transformed by i6eal with data minimisation. EMA and source-platform terms govern the underlying data and documents; no unqualified dataset-s
